title: Axanar Platform Status
tagline: Fleet status · Axanar On Demand · Donor portal · Battle for Axanar
summary: Brand and product focus shifted: Axanar On Demand leads the public site (homepage + /watch) with “Watch free. Proof we deliver.” Seven free films stream and download after a simple email unlock (display name optional later). Battle for Axanar / VIP is secondary—pricing only on vip.axanar.com—so the campaign doesn’t look cheap on axanar.com. Donate page grays unavailable multi-tier VIP packs; larger direct gifts to Axanar go to Alec via inquiry form. Signed-in members skip the free-pass gate. Donor legacy package recovery (894 restores) remains shipped; residual multi-email cases still open.

releases.title: Axanar On Demand brand lead
releases.body: Homepage and /watch re-centered on free streaming: “Watch free. Proof we deliver.” Seven titles, Core Saga + Expanded Universe, email-only unlock (nickname optional later). Signed-in members skip the free-pass gate. Battle for Axanar / VIP is secondary further down the page—pricing stays on vip.axanar.com only.

releases.title: Donate path: VIP reservation vs direct to Alec
releases.body: Multi-tier VIP pack cards that were not real SKUs are grayed out. Live Warp 9 path is the launch reservation on vip.axanar.com. Larger gifts to Axanar Productions (not Warp 9) use a public inquiry form that emails alec@axanar.com.

releases.title: Public status mirror repo
releases.body: Public GitHub repo + Pages mirror (axanar-status) so fleet status is not stuck behind the private engineering monorepo. Canonical branded page remains beta.axanar.com/status.

releases.title: Legacy portal package recovery
releases.body: Hundreds of supporter accounts had package rows on the old donor portal that never became live pledges. We bulk-imported those package histories into the current platform (idempotent restore from legacy package tables). Live pledge count rose accordingly. History is still limited to original Kickstarter/Indiegogo package exports plus that portal—other channels or emails may need a quick support conversation.

releases.title: Donor history outreach
releases.body: Open, collaborative emails to supporters whose accounts are still incomplete—inviting other emails, dates, amounts, and receipts. Staff is matching replies against multi-year campaign data; no blame, just recovery.

releases.title: Kickstarter tier restore example
releases.body: Example: a fan who saw Indiegogo perks but not Kickstarter—missing $75 Axanar KS tier restored from portal package history; account total corrected.

releases.title: Resend paid cutover
releases.body: Transactional mail From: noreply@axanar.com on Alec Pro workspace (GitHub #76). Free-tier 100/day cap no longer applies to production sends.

releases.title: Self-serve account email change
releases.body: Portal → Account → Login email. Confirmation is emailed to the NEW address; old address is notified. Pledges stay linked. Resend production From is noreply@axanar.com on paid Pro. If the new email is already on another account, use Recover Records or support.

releases.title: Shipping address reliability
releases.body: Root cause: perk shipping surveys saved addresses on survey nodes while Account → Contact only read donor_profile (~12 profiles filled vs ~284 surveys). Fix: dual-write survey→profile, hydrate GET /api/donor/me from latest survey, clearer save success UI, and one-shot drush axanar:promote-survey-addresses backfilled 224 empty profiles (0 remaining candidates). Please re-check Portal → Account → Contact & shipping; use Me too on this page if it still fails.

releases.title: On Demand premiere stack
releases.body: Free pass, full catalog stream, guided downloads, WebTorrent, comments ↔ forum, welcome email with download link.

releases.title: Donor trust sprint
